channel.title: Adam Laloge - Blog
channel.description: Blog by Adam Laloge: notes and essays on building software, testing, design, and whatever else is on the workbench.

item.title: The Prototype Is the New Sticky Note
item.description: I'm learning the design sprint from Google's UX design course — a five-day method built for a world where prototypes were expensive. The tools I've adopted deleted that scarcity, and the sprint's bottleneck moved: from building the thing to knowing whether it's true.

item.title: Anything Is Possible
item.description: This site did not exist four days ago. It was built in the open, with AI, at a pace that would have been absurd a few years ago — and that pace changes what learning means, what one person can achieve, and what I believe is possible.

item.title: The Liquid Seam
item.description: The Dreamscape's worlds melt into each other along living seams. This is the full technical story — the concept, the dead ends, two silent shader deaths, and the bisection that hunted a one-pixel line.

item.title: The Living Map
item.description: The Atlas is this site's sitemap drawn as a latent space — alive, breathing, and spaced by an algorithm. The full technical story: the questions that started it, thirty iterations in three days, the fog wars, and the solver that places the pieces.

item.title: This site is generated
item.description: Every page on this site comes out of a single Python program. As of today the blog does too — this post is the proof and the explanation.
